entries.15621b1365fd5e3a: Major printing companies, advertising agencies and wholesalers
entries.1670734e61608e04: A business conducted by a consolidated subsidiary that became a wholly owned subsidiary in June 2025. Centered on corporate customers such as major printing companies, advertising agencies and wholesalers, it receives medium-lot to large-lot printing orders through sales activities, and handles manufacturing and shipment using equipment such as silk screen printing facilities. The consolidated fiscal year includes in the scope of consolidation the period from July 1 to December 31, 2025.
entries.2c5a8dff9a8cf373: The group's single segment. It plans SP products such as nobori flags, banners, signboards, uchiwa fans and booklets, manufactures them at its own factories, and sells them through direct sales via the group of specialized EC sites "King Series" (17 sites in total), wholesale, and sales orders received through consolidated subsidiaries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥4,761 million.

entries.bc9393bebcba1d38: A business operated by the company. It accepts small-lot orders from 1 sheet or 1 copy through specialized EC sites such as "Nobori King," "Odanmaku Kensuimaku King" and "Sasshi Seihon King," and manages everything from order receipt to shipment with its in-house developed system. For customers who place large orders continuously, it assigns dedicated sales representatives and also conducts wholesale at wholesale prices.
